verdict: Ten tasks on 100,000 records, n=3, median.

title: Multi-file edits that keep the public API intact
verdict: A 7B coder handles a multi-file edit about seven times out of ten, and the failures are not random: one wrong unit, one changed return type, one inserted dataclass field. Signatures stayed compatible in 9 of 10 cases, so the API gate alone is not an acceptance test - it has to be paired with a ...

title: Writing tests for someone else's code: coverage and defect detection
verdict: A single-shot 7B coder writes tests that do not even run against the code it was given (14 of 18 fail, mostly on missing exception imports), and the subset that is green covers 22 % and catches 1 of 10 defects. Acceptance gates must run the generated tests before they are trusted; asking for branch ...

title: Censored 27B on one card
verdict: Dense 27B IQ3_S (10.95 GiB) fit entirely: decode 37.26 tok/s (tg64, n=3), prefill 837.69 on pp512 and 800.49 on pp8192, server with -c 16384 launched in 9s with 12,977 MiB VRAM, peak 13,193 MiB.

title: Uncensored Flash-Next Q2_0 under Strata
verdict: The uncensored Q2_0 is a drop-in replacement for the censored coder: same code score within noise, slightly faster, tool calling works. It answers refused topics and therefore belongs to a personal loop - never behind a public endpoint, same rule as V100-129.

title: Failure metric: 20 prompts, uncensored vs censored
verdict: Translation: 27B abliterated IQ3_S (model 2 of 3): class A 7/7 direct response, class B 9/9 direct (zero failures), class C 4/4 refusal.

title: Captcha: Local VLM vs Service
verdict: 26.11.2026, V100 16 GB, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M + mmproj-F16, 200 synthetic CAPTCHAs: distorted text 88/100 (88%), arithmetic 50/50 (100%), "how many figures" grid 15/50 (30%); total 153/200 (76.5%), average 0.11s per CAPTCHA (p95.

title: cuDNN 8 environment for graphics and video models
verdict: Positive: cuDNN 8 restores the missing convolution path on sm_70, and all three pipelines run with cuDNN enabled. It removes the engine failure, not the memory ceiling - 720p video still runs out of VRAM after the model has loaded.

title: Raw archive: nine of thirteen missing logs recovered
verdict: Mixed, and the useful half is positive: for nine cards the "missing raw" was a naming and search problem, not a lost run. For four it is a genuine loss and the caveat stands until they are re-measured.

title: Inkling 2 Mini: looped MoE, depth without weight growth
verdict: Mixed — the knob moves the token budget, not the speed: decode sits at 33 tok/s on all three levels, while high spends 51% more tokens per answer and is not better than medium (7/12 against 9/12). Loop depth is not a free quality dial on this card.

title: Gemini 4 26B-A4B in 4 bits: 16-GB sweet spot on Volta
verdict: Fits entirely and fastest among those measured on this map: prefill 2696.3 ± 94.7 tok/s on pp256, decode 124.09 ± 0.53 tok/s on tg64, peak VRAM 15331 MiB at 8k context, server ready in 5s.

title: What the 4060 Ti can do that the V100 cannot
verdict: The split is clean and measured: the 4060 Ti is the card that can train QLoRA at 398 tok/s (3B) and run bf16 paths, while the V100 is the card that serves inference with 900 GB/s and answers prefill-bound requests; routing training to the 4060 Ti and serving to the V100 is the rule these numbers ...

title: Background replacement: three methods, the deterministic one won
verdict: Positive for the catalogue path: the deterministic white background wins on untouchable product pixels and cost, while img2img and inpainting stay for interior scenes where a prompt cannot steer colour reliably. Three methods, three clear roles, no method pretending to do all three.

title: Agentic repair loop — running the tests at every step still leaves 12B at zero
verdict: Feedback is not the bottleneck: 0 of 8 with four iterations each, every patch syntactically valid and every one wrong, because the fixes need coordinated changes across files that the loop never allows.

title: Code loop on real fixes — 0 of 18, and why that is the useful result
verdict: Single-shot repair of real bugs with 12B models does not work: 0 of 18, though every patch was valid and safe. What does work in the same harness is retrieval (82.5 % recall@5 by file) and the safety gate.

title: Whole package in context — 0 of 5, plus a separate finding about q4_0 KV
verdict: Whole-package context does not rescue a 7B model: 0 of 5, and most returned files were unchanged. The useful outcome is the side finding that q4_0 KV corrupts generation while q8_0 does not.

title: A cuDNN 8 environment unblocked three tasks
verdict: Switching to cuDNN 8 is the fix for fp16 convolutions on sm_70: all three tasks run, 480p video included; 720p still runs out of memory, so on this card the limit is memory, not the build.

title: GPU Unlock: baseline measured, unlock not installed
verdict: Baseline only: the stock card was measured and the unlock was deliberately not installed, so this note answers "what we have now", not "what the unlock gives". No pass/fail is claimed.

title: IC-Light: light changes, product colour does not survive
verdict: Unsuitable for the catalogue: ΔE 24-37 against a threshold of 5-10.

title: Card quality checker without a VLM — 11 663 images, 0.1 % printable
verdict: The library is not printable: 0.1 % reaches A4 and 99.8 % is under 768 px, so upscaling is mandatory; the clipping flag is unusable, with 93.5 % false positives on flower close-ups.

title: Inkling 2 Mini on the V100: the loop core's cycles do not buy quality
verdict: Reasoning depth does not pay for short tasks: pass@1 stays flat at 0.475-0.525 across all three levels (spread ±0.15 at 95 %), while the high level doubles mean time per task (36.7 s vs 17.1 s). Decode speed is unchanged at 34 tok/s.

title: LoRA on monstera: training succeeded, no visible benefit
verdict: Training ran to completion on 30 monstera images and changed nothing visible in the product shots, so this LoRA is not worth keeping; the same budget is better spent on reference images per SKU than on a brand-wide adapter.

title: Nemotron-Bolt-E4B on the V100: 113 tok/s and honest answers
verdict: Positive with a caveat: the model reaches 113 tok/s and answers honestly on the tested questions, so it qualifies as the fast working model; SenseNova is blocked outright by the engine.

title: Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B on the V100: unblocked, but slow
verdict: Negative against the card's own bar: the model can be made to run on the fork, but the throughput it reaches is far below the 140 tok/s criterion, so the MoE shape bought memory headroom rather than speed.

title: Printing from the 640 px library — x4 reaches A4, not A3
verdict: A4 at 310 dpi is print-ready after one x4 pass at 0.7 s per card; A3 is not (219 dpi) and needs a second tiled ESRGAN pass, which doubles sharpness on the same output size but costs about a hundred times more time.

title: Background replacement with the product kept — SSIM 0.833, but details drift
verdict: Backgrounds can be replaced, the product cannot: product SSIM reaches 0.851 with depth conditioning while contour SSIM stays at 0.701, and the eye confirms redrawn petals and centres. Product cards need a manual cutout over a generated background.

title: Shop RAG assistant: Nemotron is twice as fast and three times more wrong
verdict: Negative for the RAG role: Nemotron is twice as fast but three times more often wrong against the local vikhr model, so for customer-facing retrieval it loses on accuracy.

title: Assistant on similar products — 87.5 % on full names, 15 % on short ones
verdict: Retrieval is fine and first choice is not: the right variant is in the top five 90 % of the time but first only 15 %, so the assistant must list the varieties instead of picking one, which is now enforced in the system prompt.

title: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B on the V100: 27B in 6.8 GB at 67 tok/s
verdict: Mixed: the ternary 27B does run here and holds 6.8 GB, but the throughput it reaches decides whether the trade is worth it for the shop - see the measurement above.

title: CogVideoX on V100 — blocked by the build, not by the model
verdict: With cuDNN 9 video is blocked for a build reason, not a model limit: fp16 convolutions find no engine on sm_70, and without cuDNN the VAE asks 17.8 GiB. The fix is a cuDNN 8 environment, measured in V100-141, not a smaller clip.

title: Card controller: Qwen2.5-VL-3B calls everything good
verdict: Negative: the 3B VLM accepted every card it was shown, good and bad alike, so as a controller it carries no signal - a human or a mechanical check still has to do the deciding.
